title: NAS332 Super Puma Helicopter Simulator
summary: Full-scale multi-mission tactical transport helicopter simulator with realistic rotor aerodynamics and cockpit systems.
highlights: Rotorcraft aerodynamic simulation including ground effect, autorotation, and torque response.
Complete cockpit switchology, overhead electrical/fuel panels, and dual-pilot flight controls.
Motion and visual integration for low-altitude tactical navigation and landing operations.
